reader.requirement: At --std 85 an unqualified LINE-COUNTER in the Procedure Division (a USE FOR DEBUGGING operand included) must be refused when the program specifies more than one RD and accepted when it specifies one; in the Report Section an unqualified LINE-COUNTER means the counter of the report whose RD holds it, and another report's counter is reachable only as LINE-COUNTER OF/IN that report-name (a qualifier naming no report refused).

reader.notes: Re-read after kb/Work PB2338 moved the debug operand's counter resolution from ProcedureTableBuilder into DebugDeclarativeResolver.CounterRegisterOf. The member still routes every counter through CounterResolver.ReportOf (OF/IN report-name, else the enclosing RD in the Report Section, else exactly one reachable report or COBOL2729), so the debug operand and a Procedure Division statement cannot answer differently. The count of RDs is per program, the recorded determination D-85-COUNTER-QUAL (kb/Work PB5800). The message says 'source element' at --std 85 (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/finish-worktree-wf_05bb8d55-c0a-8/runs. The single-program cases conform, the moved debug path included: cntneg-001 refuses USE FOR DEBUGGING ON ALL REFERENCES OF LINE-COUNTER and ON PAGE-COUNTER with two RDs (COBOL2729 at 29,33 and 33,33), and cntpos-001 fires the declarative on LINE-COUNTER OF R2. The open point is the count: rfcnt-001 (an outer program with RD R1 and a contained program INNER with its own RD R2) prints 'OUTER 0002 / INNER 0004' with no diagnostic, so the outer program's unqualified LINE-COUNTER is accepted although its source program, read as 1985 defines it, specifies two report description entries: 'OK  §1985:X.2.1  (║2.1 GENERAL DESCRIPTION║)  the text is in the clause; it lies in p1'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.9  (4.3.8.1 Qualification)  the text is in SRL2.9'. The compiler counts per program, which is the reading the recorded determination D-85-COUNTER-QUAL (docs/conformance/3/D-85-COUNTER-QUAL.md, kb/Work PB5800) settles; the 1985 text alone does not.

refuter.corrected: CONFORMS under the per-program reading D-85-COUNTER-QUAL records; under the literal 1985 'source program' reading an unqualified counter in a program whose contained programs specify another RD would be refused. Rests on that determination.

adjudication.reason: An unqualified LINE-COUNTER counts the report descriptions of the program it is written in (kb/Work PB5800): a recorded determination (register entry D-85-COUNTER-QUAL). The 1985 text leaves the count open (§1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.9, §1985:XIII.3.5.6 SR3); GnuCOBOL counts per program, and that decided it. The re-read after kb/Work PB2338 raised the same doubt (rfcnt-001) and nothing new.
